[[Sandra (TV series)|Sandra]] - daughter |location = |affiliation = |TV actor =[[Erik Estrada]] }} '''Adam''' is a lead farmer residing in the greater [[Los Angeles]] area {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== In 2296, Adam is scavenging for old scrap and discarded bullet casings with metal detectors. However, it is implied that he once had one or more violent encounters with [[the Ghoul]] in the past, involving a firefight.[[The Ghoul]]: ''"Lead farming, huh? Why, hell, I probably still got some of your lead in me somewhere. But today… I'm just looking for information."''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Adam eventually settled down and had three children: his older son [[Roofus]], younger son [[Tommy (TV series)|Tommy]], and daughter [[Sandra (TV series)|Sandra]]. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Radio]]=== At some point in [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]], Adam and his younger son Tommy go out on a scavenging trip, combing through the sands of the desert close to their house collecting salvage. When they return home, Tommy unloads their bounty into a pot to be melted down, while Adam removes his scavenging gear. The two then walk to their shack house, where Adam beckons to Sandra but does not receive a reply.Events of {{FOTV|1|7}} Inside the house, the two are alerted by the presence of the Ghoul as he eats a meal at their table. Unnerved, Adam again calls out to Sandra and is relieved to see her appear, serving the bounty hunter a glass of water. The Ghoul laughs at the notion that he had killed Adam's daughter and [[Cannibalism|is eating her]].[[The Ghoul]]: ''"Thank you, darling. Oh, wait. You thought…? [laughs] Come on, now."''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Adam requests that Sandra wait outside as the Ghoul comments on Adam's line of work as a lead farmer, claiming that some of his lead might still be in his body. After finishing his meal, the Ghoul reveals he came to them today just for information. Adam assures the Ghoul that they will tell him anything if he only leaves them in peace. When the bounty hunter asks about his children, Adam states that he had an older son whom they have not heard from since he aligned himself with [[Lee Moldaver]]. The Ghoul asks if the name of the other son was Roofus, but Adam claims that he did not say his name.[[The Ghoul]]: ''"Say, am I out of date, or did I hear you had three kids?"''
Adam: ''"I had an older son, but he's gone. He took up with that madwoman in the hills two years ago. We haven't heard from him since."''
The Ghoul: ''"Hmm. There's always some new little faction, ain't there? Brand-new team of believers with their own dumbass ideas about how they gonna save the world. What did you say the name of your eldest was? Was it Roofus?"''
Adam: ''"I didn't say…"''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) The Ghoul then holds up an envelope and directs his attention to Tommy, indicating the two brothers were more involved that their father knew. Adam furiously asks Tommy what he did and what was in that envelope. The Ghoul unfolds a blood-splattered letter, peering through the bullet-sized hole in the middle and reveals that Roofus got Tommy involved with Moldaver's operations. From reading the letter, the Ghoul reveals that Roofus entrusted his younger brother to pay a courier for the safe transportation of [[Siggi Wilzig|a defector]] from the [[Enclave]], to be brought to Moldaver. He then reveals that Roofus met his demise at the bounty hunter's hands, before demanding to know Moldaver's location so he can visit her and leave them be.[[The Ghoul]]: ''"Now, according to this, Roofus sent Tommy a stash of caps to pay a courier for 'the safe transport of an Enclave defector' to that very same madwoman in the hills. Moldaver. But my problem is, by the time I got this letter off your brother, it was a little bit hard to read. For some reason, I just can’t make out her location. Now, you give me that location, and I'll be on my way."''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Tommy tries to apologize to his father for bringing trouble to their home, while Adam tries repeatedly to get Tommy to give up the information.Adam: ''"Tell him, son. Just tell him."''
[[Tommy (TV series)|Tommy]]: ''"I didn't want to spend my life digging through dirt. I want to build something, and we have the chance…"''
Adam: ''"Tell him what he wants to know! Or else he's gonna kill us all! Including your little sister."''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Caving into the pressure from his father, Tommy reveals that Moldaver is at the [[Griffith Observatory|observatory]]. Believing the matter settled, Adam calmly asks that the Ghoul leave them be as he said he would. However, the Ghoul directs his attention back to Tommy, questioning if he really would let the bounty hunter go seeing how he had killed his older brother. Against Adam's vehement denial and attempts to get his son to let the matter go, Tommy gives into his desire for revenge and tries to reach for a [[flintlock musket]] to attack.[[The Ghoul]]: ''"So, what you think, Tommy? Am I really walking out of here today, or are you gonna try and draw on me for what I did to your big brother?"''
Adam: ''"He won't."''
The Ghoul: ''"Maybe not today, but maybe someday."''
Adam: ''"Tommy!"''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) The Ghoul reacts faster and shoots Tommy with his [[Dom Pedro (TV series weapon)|revolver]], killing him. He then walks out as Adam mourns the loss of his second son. ==Personality== In his interactions with the Ghoul, Adam demonstrates himself to be a dedicated family man, deeply caring for the wellbeing of his children and doing everything in his power to avoid angering the Ghoul when he comes to their home. This also extends to trying to keep them apart from the militant activities of powerful figures like Lee Moldaver. ==Notes== While scavenging, Adam and Tommy are first shown wearing aged, crudely patched up suits of [[NCR Ranger combat armor]], which was worn by the [[NCR Veteran Ranger|Veteran Rangers]] of the [[New California Republic]]. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|I'll tell you anything, as long as you leave us in peace.|Adam to the Ghoul}} ==Appearances== Adam appears only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|7=107}} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
